About
# Hire Argentinian talent with zero friction.

Totono helps US companies hire vetted Argentinian engineers with zero friction. Antonio Tralice interviews and vets the engineers, gives them the AI tools and harness he designs and controls, handles contract and payments, and supports them. Engineers do the work. You can manage the engineer yourself, or have Antonio do it.

TOTONO LLC is a Delaware limited liability company. We work remotely with clients across the Americas and Europe, on US Eastern Time.

## What you get

- Vetted Argentinian engineers: Antonio interviews and selects engineers with strong technical backgrounds and AI experience.
- AI tooling and harness: Engineers use the AI system Antonio designs and controls, for quality and velocity.
- Flexible management: You manage the engineer directly, or Antonio does. Either way Totono stays on to support them.
- Zero friction: One contract, one invoice, one point of contact. No international hiring overhead.

## Who Antonio is

Antonio Tralice is a software engineer and ed-tech entrepreneur, and a Y Combinator alumni (S20). He has spent more than a decade building web platforms, backend services and learning products. He built Totono to help US companies hire strong Argentinian engineers with zero friction.

## Who this is for

US companies that need strong engineering capacity without the overhead of international hiring. If you want to move fast, need someone who can work on your stack, and value clear communication in English or Spanish, this is for you.

US company looking for Argentinian talent? [Get in touch](https://totono.xyz/contact).
